title: JOB VACANCY CALL – SECURITY GUARD
html:
JOB VACANCY CALL – SECURITY GUARD
  • Position: Security Guard (01)
  • Duty Station: Limbe, South West Region, Cameroon
  • Job Type: Full Time
  • Reporting To: Chief of Security
  • Closing Date: Extended 18/08/2026
  • Contact: humanresource@g3-bizltd.com

G3-Biz Ltd is seeking disciplined, vigilant and ethically grounded Security Guards to safeguard the company's people, stock, vehicles, equipment, facilities and operations while maintaining high standards of integrity, accountability and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities
  • Control and monitor entry and exit of persons, vehicles, stock and company assets.
  • Maintain accurate visitor and movement registers.
  • Protect company stock, empties, vehicles, equipment and facilities against theft, damage and unauthorized access.
  • Conduct routine patrols and monitor assigned areas for security risks or unusual activities.
  • Promptly report security incidents, breaches, damages and suspicious activities.
  • Support safety and loss-prevention measures and prepare incident reports when required.
  • Maintain punctuality, discipline, vigilance, teamwork and professional conduct.
Minimum Requirements
  • Minimum GCE A/L.
  • 1 year of relevant security experience; experience in FMCG, warehouse, logistics or commercial environments is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of access control, patrol duties and incident reporting.
  • Strong integrity, vigilance, discipline and accountability.
Application Procedure

Interested candidates should submit a Cover Letter, CV, Copy of National ID, and Relevant Certificates.

Email Subject: SECURITY GUARD – G3-BIZ LTD
Send to: humanresource@g3-bizltd.com

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Due to the urgency of the position, G3-Biz Ltd reserves the right to recruit a suitable candidate before the stated deadline.

Closing date: Extended 18/08/2026
